stages.title: Opening
stages.blurb: Begin with Gone Fishing and Chapter 1, the opening checkpoints in this suggested route. Story comes first as a planning assumption about reaching the game state needed for later tasks; actual unlock dependencies are not verified.

stages.title: Chapters 2–4
stages.blurb: Complete Chapters 2, 3 and 4 in their stated sequence. Check awards at each boundary rather than assuming mission completion is chapter completion.

stages.title: Heists and story missions
stages.blurb: Work through the named mission completions. Their placement together is organizational; the descriptions do not establish the order or unlock dependencies between them.

stages.title: Friends and strangers
stages.blurb: Finish the named characters' final missions and eight stranger strands. Review Actions Speak Louder now, before major choices or the finale: its choice wording creates a precautionary missable risk, though no lockout is confirmed.

stages.title: The finale
stages.blurb: Complete the final mission after reviewing the choice warning. Placing optional strands earlier is a precaution, not evidence that post-finale access is lost.

stages.title: See all of Leonida
stages.blurb: Use exploration to work toward every meditation spot, card sets, location actions, vehicle discoveries, all of Leonida and garage ownership. Spread the long counts across earlier travel when possible; locations and exact unlocks are not supplied.

stages.title: Activities and feats
stages.blurb: Finish distinct activities, robbery conditions and remaining feats, including Actions Speak Louder. Spread the 250-stunt, 50-challenge and money totals through the route rather than saving every count for this stage; this is planning advice inferred from the totals.

stages.title: One hundred percent
stages.blurb: Audit the remaining requirements for 100% Completion last. The description does not define the game's completion checklist, so do not assume earning the other trophies alone guarantees 100%.

note: The platinum (id 1) is earned automatically when the other 54 trophies are earned.
